subject: physics
prompt: State the condition involving clockwise and anticlockwise moments for a body in rotational equilibrium.
answer_key: Sum of clockwise moments about the pivot equals the sum of anticlockwise moments about the pivot.

subject: physics
prompt: A 40 N force moves a box 3 m in the direction of the force. Calculate the work done and state its SI unit.

subject: physics
prompt: A machine has mechanical advantage 4 and velocity ratio 5. Calculate its efficiency. Then explain why a real machine cannot normally have 100% efficiency.
answer_key: Efficiency = MA/VR x 100 = 80%. Real machines lose energy mainly through friction and other dissipative effects.

subject: physics
prompt: A convex lens forms a real, inverted image that is larger than the object. State one possible position of the object relative to F and 2F and name the region where the image forms.
answer_key: Object between F and 2F; image forms beyond 2F.

subject: physics
prompt: Two transparent materials A and B have different optical densities. A ray bends more toward the normal on entering B from air than it does on entering A. Compare their refractive indices and speeds of light, giving a reason.
answer_key: B has the larger refractive index and lower speed of light because greater bending toward the normal indicates greater optical density/refractive index.

subject: physics
prompt: A sound wave has frequency 500 Hz and wavelength 0.68 m. Calculate its speed.

subject: physics
prompt: Explain why one tuning fork can make another identical tuning fork vibrate strongly even when they are not touching.
answer_key: The first fork drives air at the natural frequency of the second; matching frequencies produce resonance and a large amplitude.

subject: physics
prompt: Define electric current in terms of charge and time.
answer_key: Current is the rate of flow of charge: I = Q/t.

subject: physics
prompt: A 6 ohm resistor carries a current of 2 A. Find the potential difference across it.

subject: physics
prompt: Two resistors of 6 ohm and 3 ohm are connected in parallel across 12 V. Calculate the equivalent resistance and the total current drawn.
answer_key: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/3 = 1/2, so R = 2 ohm; total current = 12/2 = 6 A.

subject: physics
prompt: Two heaters are rated 1000 W and 1500 W at the same voltage. Compare their resistances and energy use for the same operating time. Justify both conclusions using equations.
answer_key: At fixed V, R=V^2/P, so the 1000 W heater has greater resistance. Energy E=Pt, so the 1500 W heater uses more energy for the same time.

subject: physics
prompt: Calculate the heat needed to raise 0.5 kg of water by 10 deg C. Take the specific heat capacity of water as 4200 J kg^-1 deg C^-1.

subject: physics
prompt: Equal masses of water and a metal receive the same amount of heat, but the metal shows a much larger temperature rise. What does this indicate about their specific heat capacities? Explain using Q = mcDeltaT.
answer_key: For equal Q and m, DeltaT is inversely proportional to c. The larger temperature rise means the metal has lower specific heat capacity than water.

subject: physics
prompt: Name the radiation among alpha, beta and gamma that has the greatest penetrating power.

subject: physics
prompt: A laboratory needs to reduce radiation exposure to a worker. Give two distinct protective measures based on time, distance or shielding, and explain briefly why they help.
answer_key: Any two: reduce exposure time; increase distance; use suitable shielding. Each lowers absorbed dose by limiting exposure or attenuating radiation.
